tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Terminal and pane background; the ground of every surface. Theme key inverseText, terminal background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surface: the Markdown pane and Claude Code's sidebar frame around it, bash output, document pages. text 16.55:1, accent 6.94:1, inactive 4.88:1 on it. Theme keys bashMessageBackgroundColor, composerSidebarBackground.

tokens.name: surface-user
tokens.usage: Background of the user's own messages and of code blocks in the Markdown pane. text 16.04:1 on it. Theme key userMessageBackground.

tokens.name: surface-user-hover
tokens.usage: User message under the pointer; the selected and hovered rows of the Markdown pane's file list. accent 6.19:1, text 14.75:1, inactive 4.35:1 on it. Theme key userMessageBackgroundHover.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Decorative edges only: the one-column pane edge, panel borders, table rules on pages. Never text (1.26:1 on bg).

tokens.name: row-highlight
tokens.usage: Selected and hovered rows; the empty part of the context bar. Only text, text-soft, inactive-shimmer, accent, success and warning sit on it.

tokens.name: bar-empty
tokens.usage: Empty part of the rate limit bar. Theme key rate_limit_empty.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection and the terminal selection colour. Theme key selectionBg. Only text sits on it (8.95:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Fence cream. Body text, file names and headings (bold). 17.36:1 on bg. Theme key text, terminal foreground.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Soft cream for text on a filled bar and for plan mode. Theme keys remember, planMode.

tokens.name: inactive-shimmer
tokens.usage: Secondary text on page surfaces and muted text on row-highlight (6.53:1). Theme key inactiveShimmer.

tokens.name: inactive
tokens.usage: Muted. List markers, footers, folders, inactive tabs, elapsed times. 5.12:1 on bg; fails on row-highlight (3.85:1), use inactive-shimmer there. Theme key inactive.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dim. Rules, separators, the code frame, the prompt border, open progress dots. A line colour (3.27:1), never body text. Theme key promptBorder.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Faintest ink. Swatch outlines and decoration only (1.96:1 on bg); never text or a rule that must be seen. Theme key subtle.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Picket orange. What is active or actionable: inline code, commands, paths, links, the selected file, the working state, the AI of the wordmark. 7.28:1 on bg. Theme keys claude, suggestion, permission; terminal cursor.

tokens.name: accent-shimmer
tokens.usage: Orange highlight: every clickable icon (? ⧉ ✎ ← ◂ ▸), shimmer animations and numbers in code. 11.18:1 on bg. Theme keys claudeShimmer, permissionShimmer.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success, staged changes, low usage levels. 9.88:1 on bg. Theme keys success, autoAccept.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting, your gate, unstaged changes, usage from 70%. 11.77:1 on bg. Theme key warning.

tokens.name: warning-shimmer
tokens.usage: Warning highlight. Theme key warningShimmer.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Blocked, errors, conflicts, usage from 90%. 5.04:1 on bg; never on row-highlight (3.79:1). Theme key error.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Added line background. Theme key diffAdded.

tokens.name: diff-added-word
tokens.usage: Added word background. Theme key diffAddedWord.

tokens.name: diff-added-dimmed
tokens.usage: Dimmed added line. Theme key diffAddedDimmed.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Removed line background. Theme key diffRemoved.

tokens.name: diff-removed-word
tokens.usage: Removed word background. Theme key diffRemovedWord.

tokens.name: diff-removed-dimmed
tokens.usage: Dimmed removed line. Theme key diffRemovedDimmed.
